title: Chambers of Singular Might
summary: Reach and defeat the Pixtt Annihilator in the Chambers of Singular Might.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Follow the accessible passage through the first group trial. The later sealed doors are not part of the route for Singular Might.
Defeat the Pixtt Annihilator to complete the named encounter. Its death grants a seven-hour replay lockout to the expedition.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
